issue.title: athena ~/.ssh/config dangles into the retired ~/Sync tree, so the github-bob vault remote and tailnet aliases never resolve

task_type_fields.impact: Background `bob vault-sync` on athena fails at ls-remote, so athena's vault commits (nightly `bob task archive`, `bob gkeep pull`, agent vault writes) stop reaching origin and the Mac, and Mac edits stop reaching athena. The last athena-authored push was the bob-cli-5y.13 migration commit 9253886, pushed through a /tmp ssh-config shim; the last ordinary `vault(athena)` sync was 2026-10-09 13:01. `ssh mac` (tailnet alias) also fails to resolve.
task_type_fields.repro:
Found by bob-cli-5y.13 (note #4) during the live vault migration and re-verified by bob-cli-5y.land on 2026-10-09 ~22:30 EDT on athena:

```
$ ls -la ~/.ssh/config
~/.ssh/config -> ../Sync/home/.ssh/config
$ ls ~/Sync/home
"/home/bryan/Sync/home": No such file or directory
$ ssh -G github-bob | grep ^hostname
hostname github-bob          # the alias is defined nowhere
$ git -C ~/bob remote get-url origin
git@github-bob:bobs-org/bob.git
```

Root cause: `~/.ssh/config` is a 2021-era symlink into the retired `~/Sync/home/` tree, which no longer exists, so the `github-bob` host alias (HostName github.com plus the `~/.ssh/id_bob_vault` key) that the vault's origin URL depends on resolves to nothing. `~/.ssh/tailnet.conf` (chezmoi-managed) still exists, but nothing Includes it, so `ssh mac` fails to resolve as well. The chezmoi `run_onchange` script that ensures `Include tailnet.conf` at the top of `~/.ssh/config` cannot write through a dangling symlink.

Fix in the chezmoi repo (open it with `sase repo open chezmoi`): make `~/.ssh/config` a real chezmoi-managed file (or have the run_onchange script replace a dangling symlink) that Includes `tailnet.conf` and defines `Host github-bob` (HostName github.com, User git, IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_bob_vault, IdentitiesOnly yes); then `chezmoi apply` and confirm `git -C ~/bob ls-remote origin` and `ssh -G mac` resolve. Working manual check: `GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_bob_vault -o IdentitiesOnly=yes" git ls-remote git@github.com:bobs-org/bob.git` succeeds.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-5y.13 had to push the live migration through a temporary ssh shim because athena's vault-sync cannot reach origin; athena vault commits silently stop syncing until this is fixed.
